
UPDATE-PREFIX
Update the description of a work unit prefix

USAGE
  fspec update-prefix <prefix> [options]

ARGUMENTS
  <prefix> (required)
    Prefix to update

OPTIONS
  --description <description>
    New description

EXAMPLES
  1. Update prefix description
  $ fspec update-prefix AUTH --description "Authentication and authorization"
  ✓ Updated prefix AUTH

RELATED COMMANDS
  fspec create-prefix
  fspec list-prefixes
